"""Read-only independent Q4 arithmetic and binding audit. No optimization."""
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
import collections, hashlib, json, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, zipfile

OUT=Path('.cache/pr12-rc8/q4_native_audit/output')
BUNDLE_PATH=Path('.cache/pr12-rc8/q4_native_audit/input_bundle.json')
B=json.loads(BUNDLE_PATH.read_text())
def digest(p): return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read_json(suffix, decimal=False):
    matches=[p for p in B['files'] if p.endswith(suffix)]
    assert len(matches)==1,(suffix,matches)
    path=matches[0]
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(),parse_float=Decimal if decimal else float),path
def f(x):
    assert not isinstance(x,bool)
    return F(x) if isinstance(x,(Decimal,str,int)) else F(str(x))
def dec(x):
    with localcontext() as c:
        c.prec=70
        return str(Decimal(x.numerator)/Decimal(x.denominator))
o,op=read_json('/output.json',True)
cert,cp=read_json('/certificate.json')
prior,vp=read_json('/verification.json')
capture,ep=read_json('/execution_capture.json')
pre,pp=read_json('/pre_run_binding.json')
receipt,rp=read_json('/execution_receipts.json')
delivery,dp=read_json('/pre_run_delivery.json')
check,sp=read_json('/scientific_check.json')
p=o['parameters']; ss=sorted(p['supplier_types']); ts=sorted(p['carrier_loss_rates'])
assert len(ss)==402 and len(ts)==8
assert all(set(p[k])==set(ss) for k in ('supplier_supply_capacity_m3','supplier_delivery_ratios','supplier_order_capacity_m3'))
assert set(cert['supplier_multipliers'])==set(ss)
assert set(cert['carrier_multipliers'])==set(ts)
u={s:f(cert['supplier_multipliers'][s]) for s in ss}
v={t:f(cert['carrier_multipliers'][t]) for t in ts}
assert all(x>=0 for x in [*u.values(),*v.values()])
cap={s:f(p['supplier_supply_capacity_m3'][s]) for s in ss}
cc=f(p['carrier_capacity_m3'])
assert cc==6000 and all(x>=0 for x in cap.values())
assert p['consumption']=={'A':Decimal('0.6'),'B':Decimal('0.66'),'C':Decimal('0.72')}
coeff={(s,t):(1-f(p['carrier_loss_rates'][t]))/f(p['consumption'][p['supplier_types'][s]]) for s in ss for t in ts}
orig_rows=o['question_4']['weekly_plan_repeated_for_24_weeks']['transport']
orig={(x['supplier_id'],x['carrier_id']):f(x['volume_m3']) for x in orig_rows}
flow={(x['supplier_id'],x['carrier_id']):f(x['volume_m3']) for x in cert['primal_flows']}
assert len(orig_rows)==len(orig)==len(flow)==len(cert['primal_flows'])
assert all(key in coeff and val>=0 for key,val in orig.items())
assert all(key in coeff and val>=0 for key,val in flow.items())
scale=f(cert['primal_scale']); assert 0<scale<=1
assert flow=={k:x*scale for k,x in orig.items()}
sums_s={s:sum(x for (a,b),x in flow.items() if a==s) for s in ss}
sums_t={t:sum(x for (a,b),x in flow.items() if b==t) for t in ts}
s_slack={s:cap[s]-sums_s[s] for s in ss}
t_slack={t:cc-sums_t[t] for t in ts}
d_slack={s+':'+t:u[s]+v[t]-coeff[s,t] for s in ss for t in ts}
assert all(x>=0 for x in [*s_slack.values(),*t_slack.values(),*d_slack.values()])
L=sum(coeff[k]*x for k,x in flow.items())
U=sum(cap[s]*u[s] for s in ss)+cc*sum(v.values())
gap=U-L
assert 0<=gap<=F(1,1000)
# Independent weak-duality gap decomposition confirms signs and orientation.
gap_decomp=sum(u[s]*s_slack[s] for s in ss)+sum(v[t]*t_slack[t] for t in ts)+sum(d_slack[s+':'+t]*x for (s,t),x in flow.items())
assert gap_decomp==gap
for key,result in [('lower_bound_exact',L),('upper_bound_exact',U),('absolute_gap_exact',gap)]:
    assert f(prior[key])==result
for key,slacks in [('supplier_slacks_exact',s_slack),('carrier_slacks_exact',t_slack),('dual_slacks_exact',d_slack)]:
    assert {k:f(v) for k,v in prior[key].items()}==slacks
osum_s={s:sum(x for (a,b),x in orig.items() if a==s) for s in ss}
osum_t={t:sum(x for (a,b),x in orig.items() if b==t) for t in ts}
all_ratios=[F(1)]+[cap[s]/x for s,x in osum_s.items() if x]+[cc/x for x in osum_t.values() if x]
assert scale==min(all_ratios)
original_overshoot_supplier={s:str(x-cap[s]) for s,x in osum_s.items() if x>cap[s]}
original_overshoot_carrier={t:str(x-cc) for t,x in osum_t.items() if x>cc}
# Provenance: require consistency among frozen records; no Git/network invocation.
assert capture['run_id']==pre['source_run_id']==check['run_id']==receipt['source_run_id']==B['source_run_id']
assert capture['code_commit']==pre['source_run_subject']==B['source_subject']
assert capture['output']['sha256']==cert['source_output_sha256']==prior['source_output_sha256']==check['output_sha256']==digest(op)
for name,want in {**pre['files'],**pre['raw_inputs'],**receipt['files']}.items():
    assert name in B['files'] and digest(name)==want
for code in capture['code_files']:
    if code['scope']=='CASE_ROOT':
        assert digest(code['repository_path'])==code['sha256']
assert delivery['pre_run_binding_sha256']==digest(pp)
assert delivery['code_and_protocol_subject']==delivery['observed_remote_sha']==B['certificate_code_subject']
assert delivery['verified_at']<receipt['actual_commands'][0]['started_at']
for execution in receipt['actual_commands']:
    assert execution['subject_commit']==B['certificate_code_subject']
    for stream in ['stdout','stderr']:
        log=[x for x in B['files'] if x.endswith('/'+execution['name']+'.'+stream+'.log')]
        assert len(log)==1 and digest(log[0])==execution[stream]['sha256']
    assert execution['exit_code']==0
raw_paths=[x for x in B['files'] if x.endswith('.xlsx')]
for row in capture['input_files']:
    assert o['input_hashes'][row['path']]==check['input_hashes'][row['path']]==row['sha256']
    full=B['case_root']+'/'+row['path']
    assert digest(full)==row['sha256']
# Direct XLSX XML reader: select training coordinate before reading/parsing cell numeric value.
# XML bytes for complete workbook are hashed; numeric conversions only at requested columns.
NS={'m':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
def col_num(address):
    value=0
    for ch in address:
        if not ch.isalpha(): break
        value=value*26+ord(ch)-64
    return value
def sheet_rows(path,title,max_col):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        strings=[]
        if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
            strings=[''.join(e.itertext()) for e in ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml')).findall('m:si',NS)]
        workbook=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
        rels=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
        mapping={r.attrib['Id']:r.attrib['Target'] for r in rels}
        sid=next(s for s in workbook.find('m:sheets',NS) if s.attrib['name']==title).attrib['{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id']
        target=mapping[sid]
        target=target.lstrip('/') if target.startswith('/') else 'xl/'+target
        rows=[]
        with z.open(target) as stream:
            for event,el in ET.iterparse(stream,events=('end',)):
                if el.tag!='{'+NS['m']+'}row':continue
                cells=[None]*max_col
                for cell in el:
                    col=col_num(cell.attrib['r'])
                    if col>max_col: continue
                    val=cell.find('m:v',NS)
                    if cell.attrib.get('t')=='s':
                        value=strings[int(val.text)]
                    elif cell.attrib.get('t')=='inlineStr':
                        value=''.join(cell.find('m:is',NS).itertext())
                    elif val is not None:
                        value=F(val.text)
                    else:value=None
                    cells[col-1]=value
                rows.append(cells);el.clear()
        return rows
sraw=next(x for x in raw_paths if '附件1' in x)
traw=next(x for x in raw_paths if '附件2' in x)
orders=sheet_rows(sraw,'企业的订货量（m³）',170)
supplies=sheet_rows(sraw,'供应商的供货量（m³）',170)
losses=sheet_rows(traw,'运输损耗率（%）',169)
weeks=[f'W{i:03d}' for i in range(1,169)]
assert orders[0][2:]==supplies[0][2:]==losses[0][1:]==weeks
orders=[x for x in orders[1:] if x[0] is not None]
supplies=[x for x in supplies[1:] if x[0] is not None]
losses=[x for x in losses[1:] if x[0] is not None]
assert len(orders)==len(supplies)==402 and len(losses)==8
assert len({x[0] for x in orders})==402 and len({x[0] for x in losses})==8
res={}
for row,srow in zip(orders,supplies,strict=True):
    s,typ=row[:2];assert row[:2]==srow[:2] and p['supplier_types'][s]==typ
    pairs=[(a,b) for a,b in zip(row[2:],srow[2:],strict=True) if a>0]
    if pairs:
        pos=sorted(a for a,b in pairs);index=F((len(pos)-1)*3,4)
        lo=index.numerator//index.denominator;hi=-(-index.numerator//index.denominator)
        q=pos[lo]+(index-lo)*(pos[hi]-pos[lo])
        ratio=min(F(3,2),sum(min(F(2),max(F(0),b/a)) for a,b in pairs)/len(pairs))
    else:q=ratio=F(0)
    for label,expected in [('supplier_order_capacity_m3',q),('supplier_delivery_ratios',ratio),('supplier_supply_capacity_m3',q*ratio)]:
        res[s+':'+label]=f(p[label][s])-expected
for row in losses:
    values=[x/100 for x in row[1:] if x>0]
    res[row[0]+':loss']=f(p['carrier_loss_rates'][row[0]])-sum(values)/len(values)
max_key=max(res,key=lambda k:abs(res[k]))
assert len(res)==1214 and abs(res[max_key])<=F(1,10**9)
summary={
 'status':'PASS','arithmetic_implementation':'INDEPENDENT_STDLIB_FRACTION_FROM_JSON_DECIMAL_LEXEMES',
 'dual_inequalities':len(d_slack),'dual_nonnegative_multipliers':len(u)+len(v),
 'supplier_constraints':len(s_slack),'carrier_constraints':len(t_slack),
 'primal_nonnegative_explicit_rows':len(flow),'implicit_zero_flows':len(coeff)-len(flow),
 'lexically_exact_serialized_decimal_bounds':{'lower':str(L),'upper':str(U),'gap':str(gap)},
 'decimal_approximations_70_digits':{'lower':dec(L),'upper':dec(U),'gap':dec(gap),'relative_gap':dec(gap/U)},
 'all_3626_published_slacks_match':True,'weak_duality_gap_decomposition_matches':True,
 'scale_is_maximal_common_feasible_scale':True,'primal_scale':str(scale),
 'original_supplier_overshoot_count':len(original_overshoot_supplier),
 'original_carrier_overshoot_count':len(original_overshoot_carrier),
 'original_supplier_overshoot_exact':original_overshoot_supplier,'original_carrier_overshoot_exact':original_overshoot_carrier,
 'exact_original_flow_objective':str(sum(coeff[k]*x for k,x in orig.items())),
 'original_lexicographic_stage_records':o['question_4']['optimization']['stages'],
 'raw_reader':'INDEPENDENT_STDLIB_XLSX_XML_WITH_COORDINATE_FILTER_BEFORE_NUMERIC_VALUE_PARSING',
 'raw_numeric_columns_read':'W001-W168','raw_parameter_comparisons':len(res),
 'maximum_exact_raw_parameter_difference_key':max_key,'maximum_exact_raw_parameter_difference':str(abs(res[max_key])),
 'maximum_exact_raw_parameter_difference_decimal':dec(abs(res[max_key])),
 'run_git_hash_log_bindings_consistent':True,
 'external_git_remote_event_independently_observed':False,
 'optimization_invocations':0,'original_producer_invocations':0,'constructor_invocations':0
}
def default(x): return str(x) if isinstance(x,(Decimal,F)) else str(x)
(OUT/'independent_arithmetic.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,default=default)+'\n')
(OUT/'independent_raw_parameter_residuals.json').write_text(json.dumps({k:str(v) for k,v in res.items()},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,default=default))
